description: This file is a shell script used for logging and telemetry collection related to advanced security features on a device. It sources external scripts, defines various format strings and enables conditional logging based on the presence of specific files, system configurations, and device states.

methods.name: check_status
methods.description: Main function that performs a series of checks and logs telemetry data accordingly based on device security features and configurations.

methods.name: print_telemetry_log
methods.description: Helper function to log a specific telemetry string to a given log file if it hasn't been logged already.
